relevance.description: Does the image match the alt text intent?

quality.description: Resolution, clarity, no watermarks or artifacts

hook_power.description: Would this stop a reader scrolling?

candidates.notes: Aitana Lopez portrait from Euronews editorial. High-res 1440x810, clean white background, striking pink hair immediately signals 'AI influencer'. Perfect for the comparison section — recognizable subject, professional quality. Editorial use from major news outlet.

Lil Miquela profile photo from VirtualHumans.org. Iconic look with space buns, sequined outfit. Clear CGI quality visible — demonstrates the 'virtual influencer' concept well. Good resolution, recognizable subject.

Lu do Magalu profile photo from VirtualHumans.org. 3D-rendered character with blue dress and pearl necklaces. Clearly CGI/virtual — distinct visual style from Miquela and Aitana, good for showing diversity of AI influencer approaches. Slightly lower resolution.

Kling AI 2.1 interface — Image to Video mode. Shows actual UI with upload area, prompt field, model selector, and Generate button. Clean dark theme screenshot. Excellent for tool comparison slot — shows real product interface readers will encounter.

Kling AI 1.6 interface — Text to Video mode with red annotation boxes highlighting key areas (prompt field, settings). Annotated screenshots add instructional value. Shows prompt input, negative prompt, and generation settings.

Side-by-side dual image of Lil Miquela — selfie pose and beach shot. Shows lifestyle content variety. Good for demonstrating how AI influencers create varied social content. Two images in one adds visual interest.

HeyGen logo/branding image with tagline 'AI Video Creation Tool'. Clean design with gradient background and HeyGen logo. Not an interface screenshot — it's a branding graphic. Useful as brand identifier in a side-by-side comparison but lacks UI detail.

Kling AI homepage banner — 'From Vision to Screen' tagline with beautiful AI-generated girl with flowers. Shows the brand identity and prompt input field. More of a marketing splash than a functional screenshot, but visually impressive.
Close-up selfie of Lil Miquela smiling, blue fuzzy jacket, gold necklace. Casual lifestyle shot. Good detail but we already have stronger Miquela candidates. Backup option.

HeyGen review header — split navy/gold design with HeyGen logo and 'Pros, Cons & Features' text. Blog review header graphic. Not a dashboard screenshot. Marginally relevant to img-1 hero slot — could represent the 'tool ecosystem' angle but not ideal. Recommend FAL.ai fallback for hero image.

Lil Miquela in hoodie, tongue out — casual Instagram-style selfie. Lower quality and less professional feel compared to other Miquela images. The pose is less suitable for a professional article context.
HeyGen logo only — plain text logo on light background. Too simple/minimal to serve as illustration. No interface, no features shown. Rejected.

img-2.recommendation: Use all three in a composite/side-by-side layout to match the alt text 'Comparison of three AI influencers'. Each represents a different AI influencer mentioned in the article.

img-3.recommendation: Pair Kling interface screenshot (img-3_kling_02.jpg) with HeyGen branding (img-3_heygen_01.png) for a side-by-side comparison matching the alt text.

img-1.recommendation: FALLBACK RECOMMENDED: No strong hero dashboard candidate found. The HeyGen review header is borderline acceptable. Recommend using FAL.ai (image-generator skill) to create a custom hero image showing a batch production dashboard concept.
